complianceRequirements: Operate and maintain all engine-generator sets and control devices according to the manufacturer's written instructions.

Maintain and make available on-site records including hours of operation, reason operated, generator load (with and without SCR), emissions calculations, maintenance records, fuel certifications and SCR monitoring assessments.
Conduct an annual assessment of the SCR NOx monitoring system for each set equipped.
A visible emission limit of 5% opacity except for one six-minute period per hour not exceeding 10% (startup/shutdown allows up to 10% and 20% respectively).
recordKeepingRequirements: Maintain a monthly log of hours operated for each generator, including dates and reason for operation.
Keep records of generator load, hours and SCR status, catalyst temperatures and post-catalyst NOx (ppm).
Keep monthly/annual calculations for NOx, CO, PM10, and VOC emissions for each generator using prescribed methods.
Maintain all fuel supplier certifications and stack test reports.
Maintain all Continuing SCR NOx Monitoring System Assessment records and a copy of the maintenance schedule for all generators.
Documentation of any malfunctions, bypass, shutdown or excess emissions (time, duration, cause, corrective actions).
All applicable records must be kept on-site for the most recent five years.
notifications: Notify the DEQ of construction commencement for DCD-D, DCD-E, DCD-R within 30 days.
Submit anticipated start-up dates to DEQ 30-60 days prior to start-up for DCD-D, DCD-E, DCD-R.
Submit the actual start-up date to DEQ within 15 days after start-up for DCD-D, DCD-E, DCD-R.
Notify DEQ within four business hours of any malfunction causing excess emissions over one hour.
Provide written report to DEQ within two weeks following a malfunction with all pertinent details.
Advance notification to DEQ at least 24 hours before scheduled control equipment maintenance causing excess emissions over one hour.
Permit operator must submit initial performance stack test protocols at least 30 days before test; results within 45 days of completion.
